SELECT detClass.BATCH_ID batchId,
regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_2 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type2, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_3 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type3, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_4 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type4, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_5 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type5, det.RATIO*100 ratio FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID WHERE STRATEGY_ID = #{strategyId, jdbcType = VARCHAR} GROUP BY detClass.BATCH_ID, det.RATIO ORDER BY detClass.BATCH_ID ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT strategyId, strategyName, strategyType, '' type2, '' type3, '' type4, '' type5, concat_ws('', strategyId, ',1') assetTypeId, '' fiterFlag, '' hasChildren, '' batchId, SUM(RATIO*100) ratio FROM (SELECT DISTINCT inv.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, inv.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, inv.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, det.RATIO ,detClass.batch_id FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID ) GROUP BY strategyId, strategyName, strategyType ORDER BY strategyId, strategyName

SELECT '' strategyId, '' strategyName, '' strategyType,
regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_2 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type2, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_3 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type3, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_4 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type4, regexp_replace(group_concat( detClass.TYPE_5 separator ','), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') type5, concat_ws('', inv.STRATEGY_ID, ',1,', detClass.BATCH_ID) assetTypeId, #{parentId} pAssetTypeId, '1' fiterFlag, '01' hasChildren, detClass.BATCH_ID batchId, det.RATIO*100 ratio FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY inv LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL det ON inv.STRATEGY_ID = det.STRATEGY_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL_CLASS detClass ON det.BATCH_ID = detClass.BATCH_ID
GROUP BY detClass.BATCH_ID,inv.STRATEGY_ID,det.RATIO ORDER BY detClass.BATCH_ID
